notes.title: Free demo, Arabic text support, and a new Casual difficulty update!
notes.content:
Did you say zombies?! A free demo of Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster is available now for new players to try catching the big scoop and survive the various dangers of the lavish Willamette Parkview Mall.

The latest title update adds Arabic text support and a new Casual difficulty for those who want to focus on uncovering the truth while dodging the zombie hordes.

Try the demo now!

notes.title: Hit the fairway and the zombie hordes with Frank West in Super Ultra Dead Rising 4 Mini Golf out now
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27909702/b1b4e37ad509c66d805041645573809fe7a366dc.png[/img]

“You said we were gonna play mini golf!” – Frank West, [i]Dead Rising 4[/i].


Frank West was promised mini golf and he’s going to get mini golf, as [i]Super Ultra Dead Rising 4 Mini Golf[/i] launches today on Xbox One, Windows 10 and Steam.

Bringing three modes of zombie stroking play to the tee (Online Multiplayer, Local Multiplayer and Single Player), we’ve constructed a challenge for the most avid undead golfer. With Frank in the announcer’s box offering the most colorful of color-commentary, players will take control of Connor, Isaac, Jessa and Jordan as they compete on six different courses each with four holes. Armed with an arsenal of 3 clubs, players will have a Driver for long range shots, a Wedge for shooting over obstacles and of course a Putter for putting the ball in the hole.

Players will also be able to use the Ball Buster, a wheel of misfortune that allows them to randomly select a player (including themselves) and add a status affect that can change the game such as; bouncier balls, reduced shot power, a sped up or hidden shot meter and new obstacles on the course. Truly screw over the competition for extra hilarity by playing cheap and dirty.

Of course, a [i]Dead Rising[/i] game wouldn’t be complete without the ability to pulverize zombies in a unique fashion, and driving the ball through the undead hordes will give players Zenny, the [i]Super Ultra Dead Rising 4 Mini Golf[/i] currency. This earned currency can be used to buy awesome character customization options that will let players outfit their character with a variety of new skills and looks including:

• 8 unique club sets; higher level clubs have longer range and larger sweet spots to get you closer and more accurately to the hole
• A variety of golf balls that can have explosive effects when you get the perfect shot
• 20 Exo Suits to purchase, with a variety of different colors to fit your style
• Over 10 unique helmets to add flare to your character

[i]Super Ultra Dead Rising 4 Mini Golf[/i] is included as part of the [i]Dead Rising 4[/i] Season Pass for $24.99 (USD) / €19.99 / £16.24, which is available for purchase in the Microsoft Store and on Steam. Players can also get the pack as a standalone purchase for $9.99 (USD) / €9.99 / £7.99, or get the game and Season Pass together in the [i]Dead Rising 4 Digital Deluxe Edition[/i] which is $79.99 (USD) / €79.99 / £54.99.

From zombie infection to golf swing perfection, [i]Dead Rising 4[/i] is the ideal excuse to stay inside this summer. To keep up-to-date on everything [I]Dead Rising[/i] [url=https://twitter.com/DeadRising]follow us on Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/DeadRising/]LIKE our Facebook page[/url].

notes.title: Patch #3 Now Available (Oct.10, 2016)
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch #3 Change Log:[/b][/h1][list]
[*]Background music during helicopter cutscene loops correctly. (no gap between repeats)

[*]Fixed reversed zoom in/out controls during map screen mode. Previously, pressing the analog stick 'UP' zoomed out and pulling back on the stick zoomed in. Mouse scroll direction has also been adjusted accordingly. 

[*] Improved DirectInput game pad detection.

[*]Mall music now loops in sequence and without repeating the same track. 

[*]Reduced VRAM usage (currently 1,300MB ~ 1,800MB) that may have contributed to performance degradation for certain video cards with small VRAM.[/list]

notes.title: Beta2 for Patch #3 Now Available (Oct. 7, 2016)
notes.content:
Dear Parkview Mall Shoppers,

A new beta patch went live yesterday which is now available via the opt-in beta branch. Feel free to give it a shot. (Check the beta post [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/427190/discussions/2/350542145694301755/]here[/url] for instructions and password)

It will be made available to the general public sometime next week provided there are no new issues.

Here are the changes in the latest patch:

- Background music during helicopter cutscene loops correctly (no gap between repeats).

- Fixed reversed zoom in/out controls during map screen mode.  Previously, pressing the analog stick 'UP' zoomed out (and pulling back zoomed in).  Mouse scroll direction has also been corrected.

- Additional fix to better recognize DirectInput game pads.

Above fixes are included in the latest build in addition to the changes below which were already implemented in the previous beta.

- Mall music now loops in sequence and without repeating the same track.

- Reduced VRAM usage (currently 1,300MB - 1,800MB) that may have contributed to performance degradation for some cards with small VRAM.

notes.title: Patch #2 Now Available
notes.content:
[h1][b]Change log:[/b][/h1]
Following issues have been addressed in this patch:
- Black screen and crash upon launch
- Game resolution resets to default after relaunch
- Cliff's (the machete boss) damage rate scales up with increased frame rate.
- Missing audio under certain Windows configuration

Investigation continues on a potential memory leak some users have been experiencing, which may also be a contributing factor for the framerate degradation.  

In the meantime, please try disabling DSR (downsampling) and avoid Alt-Tab task task-switching if you experience frame rate problems.

notes.title: Frank's Files: Frank West
notes.content:
[url=/jefferysimpson/go/gallery/item/153016469][img]http://images.onesite.com/capcom-unity.com/user/jefferysimpson/753fd00bf4fb098449db097b852eb9e0.jpg?v=202200[/img][/url]

To celebrate the [url=/jefferysimpson/blog/2016/08/09/dead-rising-10th-anniversary-edition]10th Anniversary of the [u]Dead Rising[/u] franchise[/url], and the release of [u]Dead Rising[/u], [u]Dead Rising 2[/u] and [u]Dead Rising 2: Off the Record[/u] on PS4, Xbox one and Steam we are taking a look at some of the characters who play a major role in the early games in the [u]Dead Rising[/u] series with "Frank's Files".

Today we begin with Frank West himself.


[url=/jefferysimpson/go/gallery/item/153027647][img]http://images.onesite.com/capcom-unity.com/user/jefferysimpson/90ea6a81c738e4d5102557a23e99ccae.jpg?v=129600[/img][/url]
[list][*][b]Name:[/b] Frank West[/*][*][b]Job:[/b] Photojournalist[/*][*][b]First Appearance:[/b] [u]Dead Rising[/u] (2006)[/*][*][b]Appears In[/b]: [u]Dead Rising[/u] (2006), [u]Dead Rising 2: Case West[/u] (2010), [u]Dead Rising 2: Off the Record[/u] (2011), [u]Dead Rising 3: Super Ultra Dead Rising 3' Arcade Remix Hyper Edition EX + α[/u] (2014), [u]Tatsunoko vs. Capcom: Ultimate All-Stars[/u] (2010), [u]Ultimate Marvel vs. Capcom 3[/u] (2011),[u] Lost Planet: Extreme Condition[/u] (2007), [u]Lost Planet 2[/u] (2010), [u]Project X Zone[/u] (2012), [u]Dead Rising 4[/u] (2016)[/*][*][b]Abilities:[/b] Frank West has good instincts, both for a story as well as how to operate in most situations. Physically strong he is capable of taking care of himself in a fight and while he claims to have never shot a gun at another person before, he is handy with a fire arm. Most of all Frank is able to use almost anything as a weapon against an onrushing zombie, no matter how outlandish and unlikely.[/*][/list]

[url=/jefferysimpson/go/gallery/item/153027649][img]http://images.onesite.com/capcom-unity.com/user/jefferysimpson/1bce66f69ad7f29c7b6e0213aa5287e4.jpg?v=123300[/img][/url]


Not much is known about Frank West’s life before he arrives in Willamette Colorado looking for the “scoop of a lifetime”. He admits to having covered wars as a journalist, though he’s not specific about which ones. What is clear is that West works freelance, doing whatever it takes to get to the bottom of the story in hopes of reaching not only the truth but fame and money when he sells the truth to the highest bidder.

Hiring a helicopter and pilot Frank flies beyond a military blockade to Willamette Colorado, believing that something is going on in the small town. There he finds America’s first zombie outbreak and a handful of survivors that have barricaded themselves in the local shopping mall.

Now working with Jessica McCarney, Brad Garrison and Otis Washington, Frank is trying to help those who have survived while uncovering a government conspiracy and dealing with more than just the zombie menace. Frank must manage to uncover the truth behind the outbreak, stop the zombie infection from spreading.


[url=/jefferysimpson/go/gallery/item/153027639][img]http://images.onesite.com/capcom-unity.com/user/jefferysimpson/b1e0f92f9fa2b811eb478fd909d02139.jpg?v=162900[/img][/url]
[Edited By Moderator]

notes.title: Patch #2 Beta Now Available
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

A new beta patch has been rolled out today that should address the following issues:

- Black screen and crash upon launch affeecting some users
- Game resolution resetting to default after relaunch
- Cliff's (the machete boss) damage rate scaled proportionately with increased frame rate.
- Missing audio under certain Windows configuration

For those who would like to give it a try, please follow the instructions [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/427190/discussions/2/350542145694301755/][b]here[/b][/url].

Patch #2 will be released to the general public as an automatic update once QA completes their test run.
